question: 今天哪个剧本卖得最好?
sql: SELECT sc.name AS 剧本, COUNT(*) AS 完成场次 FROM sessions s JOIN scripts sc ON s.script_id = sc.id WHERE s.status = '已完成' AND s.session_date = (SELECT MAX(session_date) FROM sessions) GROUP BY sc.name ORDER BY 完成场次 DESC, sc.name LIMIT 10

question: 2026年6月各剧本的完成场次排行
sql: SELECT sc.name AS 剧本, COUNT(*) AS 完成场次 FROM sessions s JOIN scripts sc ON s.script_id = sc.id WHERE s.status = '已完成' AND s.session_date >= '2026-06-01' AND s.session_date < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY sc.name ORDER BY 完成场次 DESC, sc.name LIMIT 10

question: 2026年6月哪个DM完成的场次最多?
sql: SELECT st.name AS DM, COUNT(*) AS 完成场次 FROM sessions s JOIN staff st ON s.dm_id = st.id WHERE s.status = '已完成' AND s.session_date >= '2026-06-01' AND s.session_date < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY st.name ORDER BY 完成场次 DESC, st.name LIMIT 10

question: 2026年6月各门店的营收是多少?
sql: SELECT st.name AS 门店, ROUND(SUM(s.total_amount), 2) AS 营收 FROM sessions s JOIN stores st ON s.store_id = st.id WHERE s.status = '已完成' AND s.session_date >= '2026-06-01' AND s.session_date < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY st.name ORDER BY 营收 DESC

question: 各门店的客单价是多少?
sql: SELECT st.name AS 门店, ROUND(SUM(s.total_amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(s.player_count), 0), 2) AS 客单价 FROM sessions s JOIN stores st ON s.store_id = st.id WHERE s.status = '已完成' GROUP BY st.name ORDER BY 客单价 DESC

question: 新老玩家的消费金额占比
sql: SELECT CASE sp.is_new WHEN 1 THEN '新玩家' ELSE '老玩家' END AS 玩家类型, ROUND(SUM(sp.price_paid), 2) AS 消费金额, COUNT(*) AS 到场人次 FROM session_players sp JOIN sessions s ON sp.session_id = s.id WHERE s.status = '已完成' GROUP BY sp.is_new

question: 各购票渠道的消费金额和人次
sql: SELECT sp.channel AS 渠道, ROUND(SUM(sp.price_paid), 2) AS 消费金额, COUNT(*) AS 人次 FROM session_players sp JOIN sessions s ON sp.session_id = s.id WHERE s.status = '已完成' GROUP BY sp.channel ORDER BY 消费金额 DESC

question: 2026年6月各门店目标达成率
sql: SELECT st.name AS 门店, t.target_amount AS 目标营收, ROUND(SUM(s.total_amount), 2) AS 实际营收, ROUND(SUM(s.total_amount) * 100.0 / t.target_amount, 2) AS 达成率 FROM revenue_targets t JOIN stores st ON t.store_id = st.id LEFT JOIN sessions s ON s.store_id = st.id AND s.status = '已完成' AND strftime('%Y-%m', s.session_date) = t.month WHERE t.month = '2026-06' GROUP BY st.id, st.name, t.target_amount ORDER BY 达成率 DESC

question: 各剧本类型的营收分别是多少?
sql: SELECT sc.category AS 剧本类型, ROUND(SUM(s.total_amount), 2) AS 营收 FROM sessions s JOIN scripts sc ON s.script_id = sc.id WHERE s.status = '已完成' GROUP BY sc.category ORDER BY 营收 DESC

question: 每个月的营收趋势
sql: SELECT substr(session_date, 1, 7) AS 月份, ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS 营收 FROM sessions WHERE status = '已完成' GROUP BY 月份 ORDER BY 月份

question: 完成场次最多的前5个剧本
sql: SELECT sc.name AS 剧本, COUNT(*) AS 完成场次 FROM sessions s JOIN scripts sc ON s.script_id = sc.id WHERE s.status = '已完成' GROUP BY sc.name ORDER BY 完成场次 DESC, sc.name LIMIT 5

question: 复购玩家有多少?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 复购玩家数 FROM (SELECT sp.player_id FROM session_players sp JOIN sessions s ON sp.session_id = s.id WHERE s.status = '已完成' GROUP BY sp.player_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2)
